description: Figure 2 presents a bar chart illustrating a comparison of recall scores across different methods—critiquing, scoring, and ranking—on the INSPIRED dataset. The horizontal axis displays the method categories: “critiquing,” “scoring,” and “ranking,” listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Recall@10,” represents recall scores with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05.  Four sets of bars are presented for each method, representing different experimental conditions: Ours, NDCG@10, CRSS, and zero-shot. The “Ours” bars are blue, the “NDCG@10” bars are light blue, the “CRSS” bars are gray, and the “zero-shot” bars are white. For “critiquing,” the bar heights are approximately 0.05 for “zero-shot,” 0.10 for “CRSS,” 0.20 for “NDCG@10,” and 0.25 for “Ours.”  For “scoring,” the bar heights are approximately 0.05 for “zero-shot,” 0.10 for “CRSS,” 0.20 for “NDCG@10,” and 0.30 for “Ours.” For “ranking,” the bar heights are approximately 0.05 for “zero-shot,” 0.10 for “CRSS,” 0.20 for “NDCG@10,” and 0.35 for “Ours.” The bars are not visually emphasized or annotated in any particular way.
